period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary half-yearly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for half year ended 30 June 2011 (Unaudited)"), used as the Q2 data point per project convention. This filing explicitly presents both 'Year-to-Date' (Jan-Jun cumulative, used here) and 'Current Quarter' columns for the P&L. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 30 June 2011 (Unaudited)' / unlabelled 'Profit and Loss Account for the half year ended 30 June 2011') figures are used, not 'Consolidated'. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 84,508.02m + Total equity 12,565.32m = Total assets 97,073.34m exactly; EPS of 25.59 reconciles with Net profit after tax (995.05m) / paid-up shares (38,885,472 shares — paid-up capital of BDT 3,888,547,200 at a BDT100 face value per share, before the bank's later stock split to BDT10 face value reflected in the much larger 2012+ share counts). Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported); not a single reported line in this primary document. NAV per share is not disclosed in the primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap. This is also the earliest primary interim statement recovered for City Bank in this dataset (2011 Q1 and Q3 exist only as scanned/image PDFs pending separate OCR/vision extraction).
